items.raw_excerpt: Jornada de tensión en la embajada de Haití: Denuncias por cobros irregulares, demoras y operativo policial
items.summary_en: People accuse the Haiti embassy in Chile of charging unfair fees. Visitors also faced long delays for their documents. Police came to the embassy as the situation grew tense.
items.summary_ko: 칠레에 있는 아이티 대사관이 사람들에게 부당한 돈을 받았다는 항의가 나왔다. 방문자들은 서류를 받느라 오래 기다려야 했다고 한다. 상황이 긴장해지자 경찰이 대사관에 나갔다.
items.title_en: Tension at the Haiti Embassy in Chile

items.raw_excerpt: Explore the transformation of Chennai through captivating archival images in celebration of Madras Day.
items.summary_en: Chennai celebrates Madras Day with old photographs of the city. The pictures show streets, buildings, and daily life from many years ago. Readers can compare past and present to see how the city has changed.

items.raw_excerpt: Bristol City's Dom Ballard scores a goal that's left many fans saying the Puskás Award may already be over for the season.
items.summary_en: Dom Ballard of Bristol City scored a beautiful backheel goal in an English league match. Many fans said it could already win the Puskas Award for best goal of the season. The video spread quickly online.
